title: Husqvarna Vitpilen 250 Neo (Adventure Spec)
description: Representing KTM's prowess in the Heritage Cafe Racer class, the KTM Husqvarna Vitpilen 250 Neo (Adventure Spec) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 250cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
